description: An administrator's word that one week may have more reconfigurations than the ceiling: up to 'count', or as many as it has now. Every later write of that week — a bot's too — is held to it. Only somebody who configures the project.

count.description: How many it may have. Leave out for as many as it has now.

week.description: Any day of the week, YYYY-MM-DD; the week runs Monday to Sunday.
